title: Prototyping Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
We develop connected devices for smart homes and need a hands-on engineer for our prototyping lab.

What you'll do
- Turn concepts into functional prototypes using 3D printing, CNC parts and simple electronics
- Design housings and brackets in CAD
- Run test series and write short test reports
- Work with designers and firmware engineers on iterations

What you bring
- Bachelor's degree in mechatronics, mechanical or electrical engineering
- 1-3 years of prototyping experience, student projects count
- Experience with Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks or similar
- Basic Arduino or Raspberry Pi skills; English is the team language, German is a plus
